blocks.x: Okay, we're on the second reel. Al Rose, same date. August 13th, 1989. Okay, we left off with Eus... Eus Panassia.

Eus Panassia. Yeah. But I had been over in Paris just shortly before that, and I had had Bechet with me, and I introduced him to Lutair, and he was supposed to come back with me, but he stayed there, and he stayed for seven years. So I didn't have to bring him back, because he was there already. But anyway, I started to round up the musicians for that. Now, I was lucky enough to see Louis here just before that, because he was here to be king of the Zulus in 1949.
Do you know any of the background on that, how Louis became king, or what was his...
Well, I guess they just wanted him, and they invited him, you know. Oh, okay.
No, I don't have any background on that, but Louis was very happy about it. He was? Yeah. And of course, if you wanted to talk to Louis, you had to talk with Ira. You know how that worked.
